query.en: Design a bold birthday party invitation (portrait card): high-contrast color-block background, the age/number set as a huge playful numeral as the dominant graphic element, the 'you're invited' headline beneath it, and a clear info block (date, time, location, RSVP) in a smaller consistent weight. One or two saturated accent colors, no gradients, no stock party-clipart (balloons/confetti icons). Use `—` placeholders for any details not given to you.
